name: GL Tech Co.,Ltd
summary: GL Tech Co.,Ltd operates globally and within China, focusing on the development, production, and sale of advanced equipment for semiconductor packaging and testing. Its product line includes specialized processing machinery for assembling and evaluating semiconductors and microelectronic devices, as well as precision scribing and cutting tools utilized in manufacturing semiconductor components like integrated circuit chips, sonar, and various sensors. The company also provides critical high-precision elements such as air static and dynamic pressure spindles, air guides, rotary tables, precision linear guides, and drivers, which are essential for the cutting and grinding stages of semiconductor chip packaging. In addition to its semiconductor offerings, GL Tech delivers comprehensive safety production monitoring products, covering mine safety, power grid security, and broader energy conservation and environmental protection solutions, alongside related support equipment. Its extensive portfolio in this area includes intelligent and precise gas extraction systems, integrated platforms for anti-outburst control, goaf (mined-out area) fire source detection systems, and ground communication and personnel positioning technologies. The company further provides various testing instruments and environmental management solutions, such as laser ammonia escape detection, ammonia injection optimization, continuous NOx monitoring, and fly ash carbon content analysis, all complemented by specialized equipment aimed at improving boiler energy efficiency and reducing emissions. Founded in 1994 and headquartered in Zhengzhou, China, the company was formerly known as Zhengzhou Gl Tech Co.,Ltd before officially changing its name to GL Tech Co.,Ltd in September 2017.
